entries.name: Glass hover reveal card
entries.semantic_description: A glassmorphism card with translucent surface, backdrop blur, elevated edge glow, and delayed content reveal on hover. Useful for premium dashboards, feature grids, pattern catalogues, and AI product showcases where the card should feel layered, polished, and slightly atmospheric rather than flat.
entries.css: .glass-hover-reveal-card{position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:1.25rem;border-radius:1.25rem;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.26),rgba(255,255,255,.12));border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.24);backdrop-filter:blur(18px);box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(15,23,42,.12);transition:transform .28s ease,box-shadow .28s ease,border-color .28s ease;}.glass-hover-reveal-card .reveal-copy{opacity:.72;transform:translateY(10px);transition:opacity .28s ease .04s,transform .28s ease .04s;}.glass-hover-reveal-card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 28px 60px rgba(15,23,42,.18);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.42);}.glass-hover-reveal-card:hover .reveal-copy{opacity:1;transform:none;}

entries.name: Pulse icon action button
entries.semantic_description: An action button with a pulsing shadow aura, rotating or shifting icon, and coordinated color transition across background, text, and border. Good for hero actions, AI tool launch buttons, and strong call-to-action areas that need a lively but controlled interaction signal.
entries.css: .pulse-icon-action-button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.7rem;padding:.9rem 1.15rem;border-radius:999px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#111827,#1f2937);color:#fff;transition:transform .22s ease,box-shadow .22s ease,background-color .22s ease;box-shadow:0 0 0 rgba(34,211,238,0);}.pulse-icon-action-button .icon{display:inline-block;transition:transform .22s ease,color .22s ease;}.pulse-icon-action-button:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 0 0 8px rgba(34,211,238,.08),0 18px 38px rgba(17,24,39,.22);background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0f172a,#164e63);}.pulse-icon-action-button:hover .icon{transform:rotate(18deg) scale(1.08);color:#67e8f9;}

entries.name: Loading dots stagger
entries.semantic_description: A compact loading indicator made of staggered dots that pulse, jump, or breathe in sequence using animation-delay. Useful for inline async states, semantic search loading, progressive generation, and compact status surfaces where a spinner would feel too heavy.

entries.name: Stagger grid feature cards
entries.semantic_description: A feature-card grid where each card enters with a slight stagger delay and lifts on hover. Intended for capability galleries, pricing comparisons, dashboards, and pattern browsers where repeating cards should feel orchestrated rather than dumped at once.
entries.css: .stagger-grid-feature-cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:1rem;}.stagger-grid-feature-cards > article{opacity:0;transform:translateY(18px) scale(.98);animation:stagger-grid-card .46s ease forwards;transition:transform .22s ease,box-shadow .22s ease;}.stagger-grid-feature-cards > article:nth-child(2){animation-delay:80ms;}.stagger-grid-feature-cards > article:nth-child(3){animation-delay:160ms;}.stagger-grid-feature-cards > article:nth-child(4){animation-delay:240ms;}.stagger-grid-feature-cards > article:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 18px 38px rgba(15,23,42,.12);}@keyframes stagger-grid-card{to{opacity:1;transform:none;}}

entries.name: Pointer starfield depth
entries.semantic_description: A pointer-reactive depth field made of layered particles or stars moving at different rates to simulate parallax in a 3D scene. Best for hero backdrops, tech showcases, experimental intros, and decorative but controllable ambient canvases.

entries.name: SVG path draw sequence
entries.semantic_description: An SVG path drawing sequence where strokes animate into view using dash offset, optionally followed by fill reveal or secondary motion. Useful for logo intros, diagram emphasis, feature illustrations, and branded onboarding moments.

entries.name: Marker syntax highlight
entries.semantic_description: A marker-like text highlight treatment for semantic phrases, code-inspired callouts, and poetic annotations. Uses an angled painted background, slight inline padding, and a hand-marked emphasis rather than a flat rectangular tag. Suitable for editorial hero copy, annotated interfaces, and text-led experimental layouts.

entries.name: Progressive text reveal
entries.semantic_description: A progressive character or token reveal interaction for text-first interfaces. Supports staged output, reading rhythm, and semantic emphasis as letters or words fade in over time. Useful for poetic UI, prompt demos, landing hero copy, and guided narrative blocks.

entries.name: Glyph mouse reactive
entries.semantic_description: A split-text interaction where individual glyphs react to pointer position with local rotation, scale, or offset. Designed for experimental hero typography and expressive headings where letters feel alive but remain readable. Strong fit for showcase pages and interactive headline systems.

entries.name: Hybrid grid flex clamp layout
entries.semantic_description: A hybrid editorial layout that combines CSS grid for macro structure and flex for local alignment. Uses clamp-based spacing and fluid viewport sizing, aspect-ratio media boxes, and responsive containers that stay balanced across desktop, tablet, and tall mobile viewports. Good for showcase pages, design catalogues, and experimental dashboards.

entries.name: Scroll reveal with progress bar
entries.semantic_description: A scroll-triggered visibility system that reveals sections as they enter the viewport while also updating a reading or progression bar. Combines Intersection Observer for activation with a lightweight scroll progress indicator. Useful for long landing pages, docs, and presentation-style pages.

entries.name: Gradient outline icon button
entries.semantic_description: A call-to-action button with an animated gradient outline, masked border treatment, and a secondary icon that can rotate or shift on hover. Strong fit for premium landing pages, AI product heroes, and bold marketing CTAs where the button should feel active before click.

entries.name: Snap slider carousel
entries.semantic_description: A horizontally scrolling slider or carousel with scroll snapping, motion-aware navigation controls, and animated pagination dots. Designed for showcases, product rails, and testimonial groups where touch scrolling should feel native and button navigation should remain available.

entries.html:
Implementation notes

How section-first retrieval changes page quality

Section-capable entries give the planner larger structural units, which improves bundle assembly and reduces fallback repetition across major slots.

Key point: retrieval quality is not just about semantic similarity. Structural usefulness matters too.

Recommended workflow

Start from archetype classification, derive a slot plan, then retrieve section shells, support modules, and style layers.

Checklist

  • Prefer section-level candidates
  • Audit noisy micro-fragments
  • Track fallback pressure

Debug focus

Inspect base/layouts/sections/support bundle composition for each slot.
